name: Task Status Cycler
description: Complete Pomodoros while carrying worked-on/deferred links, narrowing the closed name to worked types and shedding uncarried types from the created Pomodoro, and copying each Task Link sub-bullet's sub-sub-bullets into the linked task's Work Log, toggle empty Pomodoro placeholders/sub-bullets with Ctrl+Alt+] including named placeholders, toggle Obsidian tasks with Ctrl+Shift+] (a Vim count N<Ctrl+Shift+]> toggles the cursor item and the next N sibling items together, prompting at most once and sending the whole group to one section) — always prompting for promotion destinations when exact Tasks exists (Enter defaults to Tasks conversion, including in place when already there; typing creates a new section; non-Tasks stays plain; empty non-Tasks source sections are removed) and for demotions from Tasks — cycle Blocked tasks out with option+[/option+], recover affected Blocked dependents, propagate Ctrl+Enter to embedded task transclusions, and preserve embedded-task behavior. Ctrl+Enter on a Task Link closes the linked task and strikes the link, embedded or plain. A versioned `api.recoverBlockedDependents` lets other plugins recover Blocked dependents without retiring references; dependents with a strictly future `scheduled` date stay Blocked, and Ctrl+Enter on a Task Link to a Cancelled task shows a notice instead of completing the owning Pomodoro. Depends-On lines (managed ⛓️ **DEPENDS ON:** child bullets) are never struck, restored, reformatted, or tree-closed: Ctrl+Enter closes or reopens the linked prerequisite only, and Alt+[ / Alt+] cycle the link under the cursor. Ctrl+Enter on the PRE/POST row the bob-navigation-hotkeys review walk just landed on hands off to nav api v2, which completes the row and advances within its group when another live row remains. Alt+[ / Alt+] on a Pomodoro Task Link instead toggles the linked task between Next and In Progress through the nav api.taskLinkLane v1 namespace, never reformatting the bullet. Closing a planned task recovers what it unblocked and offers successor choices through nav `api.successors` v3 (hand-offs, project residents, project-finished pull-ins, keep-moving rows for leaf sub-projects when `plan.keep_moving` is enabled, and configured `relations.successor_labels` standing offers on managed Done and on Unlink of a Pending task with no live Task Link left today through `api.offerParkedSuccessors` (api v4)) — dependency and project offers gated on `[id::]`, relation offers from accepted LINKS even without ids — through open editors or preimage-checked vault writes, honouring `plan.link_unblocked` — and reports the result through nav `api.notice` v3 for relation and keep-moving rows (plain relation copy when notice is older than v3), the existing Unblocked card for other rows, the walk toast on review landings, or a plain notice without a compatible nav API. Reopening the predecessor the same day through Ctrl+Enter takes back untouched successor links and restores their statuses from an in-memory receipt; Alt+]/Alt+[ moves into Done join the same pass, while moves into Cancelled recover only. Project Schedule comes from the ^prj task; tagged #prj_is_blocked residents stay Blocked until project recovery, which strips the tag from every open resident including those that remain Blocked for their own reasons, never edits closed lines, and records [unblocked::] through ledger-tools v12 when available (otherwise it recovers with a console warning, including on the successor apply path). Alt+] / Alt+[ on a [?] ^prj that leaves the project with no remaining reason — a future date or an open Depends-On target resolved against the vault; a missing id never blocks — recover those open residents in the same gesture, including when Alt+[ cancels ^prj so the note is no longer project(T), and when the cycled ^prj is transcluded from another note. A tagged #prj_is_blocked ^prj inherits its parent project’s Blocked reason and cannot be cycled; closing its last open sub-project pulls in the parent ^prj. LINKS and LINKED FROM rows are not Pomodoro Task Links; Ctrl+Enter and Alt+] / Alt+[ act on their target root-only without formatting the row. Ctrl+Enter on a timed Pomodoro stamps the closed row `[off:: Nm]` when every Task Link it keeps is `#offclock` (aliases `#off-clock`, `#untracked`) and `[t:: Nm]` otherwise, with a notice when a session stays on the clock while linking an off-clock task; timed MEET closes place the carried continuation after the last open Pomodoro and leave the cursor on the next open entry.
